evd_title: ChatGPT diverged most from humans in the conclusion domain with mean difference 0.764 on CONSORT-A
finding: ChatGPT diverged most from humans in the conclusion domain with mean difference 0.764 on CONSORT-A
P: 30 implant-dentistry RCT abstracts (Menne, Pandis & Faggion 2021 SR)
I: ChatGPT GPT-3.5 (no version pin), zero-shot fixed prompt with CONSORT-A item definitions; single run
C: 2 clinician reviewers (consensus >=80%, then one reviewer solo)
O: Per-domain mean abs. OCS difference: conclusion highest 0.764 (reported 95% CI 0.186-0.280 excludes it), p<0.001, r=0.06
